mechanism: Both drugs increase gastrointestinal irritation and ulceration risk; minocycline may impair renal function and enhance ketorolac accumulation; NSAIDs reduce renal perfusion which can worsen tetracycline-related nephrotoxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest ketorolac dose for shortest duration, monitor renal function, and consider gastroprotection with PPI; ensure adequate hydration.
